description: Deletes ALL registrants of one webinar in one step. Side effect: every entry is gone from the site and cannot be restored, the numbers fall to zero, and the people disappear from the funnel; already sent emails are not recalled. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` and a clear yes (`confirm` true). Read the count first with wi_list_webinar_leads_registrants and say the number out loud, because this cannot be undone. To remove one person use wi_delete_registrant. For a backup before deleting, read the list with wi_export_registrants_csv.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that every registrant of this webinar may be deleted.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_delete_all_registrants
title: Delete every registrant of a webinar
